# Original regular-expression sources

These eight complete original data files and the MIT license are from v2fly/domain-list-community revision 1daade8c4bb957d21d1f5c09c2b050d699e8e96c. They substantiate the 24 selected regular-expression records in metadata/upstreams.json (13 distinct expressions); they are not eight new rule sets and are not all activated in any profile.
